title: Law to require guide on youth incarceration alternatives
summary: This bill would require the Administration for Children's Services, working with other city agencies, to develop and regularly update a guide listing alternatives to incarceration and detention programs for youth. The guide would include each program's services, eligibility, location, bed availability and contact information, and would be distributed to judges, attorneys, public defenders, youth advocates and district attorneys. The law would take effect 180 days after enactment.
